blurb: High Tide Aviation provides professional pilot training for commercial licenses, instrument ratings, helicopters, and flight instruction. They offer zero-to-hero flight training programs and introductory flights over scenic coastlines. Training is available under Part 141 and Part 61 with modern aircraft and simulators.
extraNote: Gift certificates are final sale and non-refundable

quotes.text: I took my daughter on an airplane Discovery Flight and we both loved it. She even got to handle the controls during the lesson! If we lived nearby, she would definitely take flight training from High Tide Aviation. Willis was a great instructor and a huge encouragement to her. Now, I want to do it!

I earned my private pilot license through High Tide out of St Simons Island, GA. They are an excellent program with a great cadre of instructors. I am very thankful to have had such a great team to help me start this journey into aviation!

Life is too short to fly commercial and be treated like dirt. Fly High Tide Aviation and set your own schedule. Be treated like an appreciated customer flown by folks who love what they do. When it works, it works.
Great flight school. Keith Blackmon MEI really knows what he is doing and will train you to be a very skilled and confident multi-engine pilot. Excellent time with High Tide Aviation!
The pilot was so patient and made me feel at ease at all times. Was very attentive to give the experience that was important to me! Thank you!
